title: Research
section: Variability and learning in recurrent networks
text:
Variability and learning in recurrent networks
Trial-to-trial variability is often treated as noise. In developing circuits it may instead reflect the state of a network that is still being shaped. This line of work asks how variability changes with learning in two-dimensional recurrent networks.

title: Research
text:
Cross-species comparison
Comparing cortical organisation across species, for example ferret, cat and tree shrew, constrains which developmental mechanisms are general and which are specific.

title: Sigrid Trägenap
text:
I am a computational neuroscientist at the Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies (FIAS). I study how the developing cortex organises itself: how spontaneous activity, recurrent connectivity and experience shape the functional maps that emerge in early life.
My work combines mathematical models of recurrent networks with analyses of experimental data from developing visual cortex.
